name_hash.algorithm: h=0; feed bytes of: shader name, profile string (object+0x18, e.g. "vs_3_0"; empty for shaders created with the default profile), [global string 0xC796D8 only when the platform argument is 0 - empty in every name that was reproduced], then each define string in stored order (alphabetical in every reproduced name). Per byte, LSB first: top=h>>31; h=(h<<1)|bit; if top: h^=0x04C11DB7. Finish with 4 zero bytes (0x9E8668). File name = name + signed-decimal(h) + ".bin".

DeferredMain2VS (REDeferredMain2, model.TERRAIN: COLOR0.a = terrain layer id: o1.w = (|a - $terrainTextureNr| < 0.001); rgb passed only with VERTEX_COLORS
DeferredMain2VS (REDeferredMain2, model.pixel: DeferredMain2PS (all 16): oC0.rgb = lerp(lit * v0.rgb, $fogColor, fog) ; oC0.a = diffuseMap.a * v0.a ; lit = (ambient+dir+deferred lights [+glow*effectFactors.yzw]) * diffuseMap + (specular [+glow]) * specMap [+reflection]; FALLOFF variants add the falloff term after the multiply

DeferredMainVS (REDeferredMain/REDeferre.VERTEX_COLORS: o1 = COLOR0 (rgba, no alphaFactor in VS)
DeferredMainVS (REDeferredMain/REDeferre.pixel: DeferredMainPS: lit *= v0.rgb before fog; oC0.a = alpha * v0.a; UNLIT variants read only v0.a

MainVS (forward REMain etc.).always: o1 = COLOR0 (no VERTEX_COLORS define; white vertices are a no-op)
MainVS (forward REMain etc.).pixel: MainPS: lit * v0.rgb then fog; oC0.a = alpha * v0.a; UNLIT variants only v0.a

HairVS / GlassWaterVS / TexturingVS / Sk.pixel: HairPS: lit*rgb, alpha*a; GlassWaterPS(GLASS): oC0.a = v.a only; DiffuseTexturingPS: tex*colour

GrassVS / GrassDepthVS.always: COLOR0*256 (c6.x / c9.x) -> floor -> array indices into $grassData (per-corner quad index), not a colour

ShadowVolumeVS (SKIN).always: COLOR0 here is the bone-index quad of vertex format 10 (D3DCOLOR @20), not a colour
